description: Directly recorded in source for the field at the event grain.
Deterministically deduced from other recorded fields with no model.
notes: Deduction is reproducible from rules; usable as labels.

description: Value known only at aggregate grain (box/gamelog/season totals).
notes: Use as aggregate constraint; never as event-level label.

description: Field absent or null with no usable replacement.
notes: Distinct from sentinels with semantic meaning.
Carries information that source did not know; not the same as missing.
Source emitted the structural default rather than a real value.

description: Field is structurally inapplicable for the event.
notes: E.g. assist position on a strikeout with no fielder.

description: Value contradicted by another evidence source.
notes: Surface in data-error ledger; do not train on as truth.

description: Value flagged by data-error risk ledger as suspect.
